{{Quote|Don't worry, we'll think of something.|Derrik Reed|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Derrik Reed''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Private/Legends|Private]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
Stationed on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]], he served under [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Nic'ala]] where they assisted in retaking the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], but were stumbled when the Empire has produced new stealth bombers at the [[Balmorran Arms Factory]] and planned to cripple their forces. While meeting a fellow Republic citizen, Private Reed devised a means of crippling the vessels before they could be launched. He produced several overload modules that would short out the bombers' electrical systems when deployed.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1st}}
